name: nostr-vpn
description: Set up and inspect a Nostr VPN private mesh with the nvpn CLI. Use local keys and signed administrator approval instead of a VPN provider account. Connecting requires host networking permissions.

interface.longDescription: Set up and inspect a Nostr VPN private mesh with the nvpn CLI. Use local keys and signed administrator approval instead of a VPN provider account. Connecting requires host networking permissions. Requires the command line tool on the execution host; the plugin provides instructions and does not install software or change settings by itself.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer can run Nostr VPN and help me join an approved private network.
